summary: Apalachicola NF lookout at Wilma: a 1936 state map shows a ranger lookout station, and a 1967 survey rated the station in good condition. No later source found.

facts.status_note: The last description is from 1967, when the station was in good condition. No later source says whether the tower still stands.

events.note: A ranger told the 1967 survey that the tower had been in the same place since 1934. The survey does not give a construction date.
A 1936 Florida State Road Department map of Wilma shows a forest ranger lookout station.
Coast and Geodetic Survey description rates the station as in good condition.

notes_for_editor: Three sources, none of them recent. The 1934 date is a ranger's statement recorded in 1967, not a build record. The 1936 map shows a lookout station, which may or may not be this tower. The NPS History page's own date is not visible; the page shows only a 2010 last-updated stamp, and it does not name a USDA handbook, so no such attribution is made. No source describes the site after 1967. Access is not recorded, so no access field is set.
